scope: Scoped symbol/date acquisition-outcome reviews that can certify background negatives. Empty or incomplete reviews intentionally certify no negatives. complete=true only after identity, search method, and no qualifying public-target >=15% reaction are documented.
complete_review_requires: Explicit symbol and exchange-session window from feature close through the tenth subsequent session close.
Verified historical security identity for that symbol across the window, including ticker changes, share class, and ADS terms.
Documented search method with source locator (registry query, filing search, or named primary sources).
Statement that no qualifying public-target acquisition announcement with a measured >=15% close-to-close reaction was found inside the window.
Retention of any borderline public processes, rumors, or non-qualifying deals as unresolved rather than negative.
review.complete set true only after the above are satisfied; incomplete searches never invent label 0.

reviews.locator: Background observation CSCO:2016-02-24; outcome sessions 2016-02-25..2016-03-09; identity CIK 0000858877 Cisco Systems, Inc. ticker CSCO Nasdaq; news search Feb–Mar 2016 Cisco as public M&A target; stockquote close-to-close audit in-window
reviews.search_method: 1) Confirm historical identity via SEC submissions CIK0000858877 (name Cisco Systems, Inc.; tickers=['CSCO']; exchanges include Nasdaq) with continuous CSCO stockquote rows spanning the window. 2) News/search for contemporaneous reports of CSCO as a public acquisition/takeover target with a measured >=15% close-to-close reaction inside 2016-02-25..2016-03-09 (ignore earnings; Cisco-as-acquirer deals are non-qualifying for this target-outcome definition). 3) Audit optiondb.stockquote consecutive-session closes from feature close 2016-02-24 through 2016-03-09 for any >=15% close-to-close move.
reviews.notes: In-window news shows Cisco as acquirer (CliQr announced ~2016-03-01; Leaba ~2016-03-02) and earlier Feb 3 Jasper / Feb 10 earnings-buyback move outside this outcome window—not CSCO as public target. Max absolute close-to-close return inside the audited window is +2.48% on 2016-03-01. No qualifying public-target acquisition announcement with >=15% reaction found. No borderline CSCO-as-target rumor retained as unresolved for this window.
non_qualifying_related_news: Cisco intent to acquire CliQr (~2016-03-01) — acquirer, not target
Cisco intent to acquire Leaba (~2016-03-02) — acquirer, not target
